notes.title: UPDATE 1.5: Change Log (Steam Leaderboard)
notes.content:
[b]Steam Leaderboard[/b]
You must earn at least 3 Stars to qualify for a Leaderboard entry. There are Leaderboards for all 27 levels in the game.

You should exit the Steam client, and restart Steam to make sure the game is updated successfully. Once the game is updated, play the game until you have earned 3 stars on any level.  You can then check your Leaderboard results by visiting our ‘Global Gameplay Stats’.

http://steamcommunity.com/stats/462960/leaderboards/1436096/

Best of Luck!

notes.title: Achievements Now Available
notes.content:
We are really happy to announce that achievements are now available.
There are 14 achievements to unlock.

However, there is a catch. If you have played Caveman World in the past, you will need to "RESET" the game's save file before some of the achievements can be unlocked.

We have provided a reset button which is only available on the splash screen as the game loads. You only have few seconds to push the reset button.

There is an alternate way to do this. You can simply delete the saveData file located in the games folder. 

If you have any questions, feel free to reply to this post.

Have fun!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.4: Change Log
notes.content:
[b]Show Exit Door on Key Pick-Up[/b]
When you pick up a key, the door is automatically unlocked. The camera now pans to the door momentarily to reveal which door has been opened, then quickly returns to player.

[b]Levels Unlocked[/b]
The first level of each episode has been unlocked. This allows you to explore the more difficult levels without having to complete the previous episodes.  Check out Episode 2: Level 1 to start breaking some Eggs.

[b]Achievements Now Available[/b]
Added 14 Achievements.

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
[b]Tweaked Trampolines[/b]
I added a bit of upwards force to the trampoline to assist in jumping, and also to correct an issue where the bounce pad wasn't returning to center gravity fast enough. I'm hoping this will improve game play slightly.

[b]Added Geysers[/b]
There's a lot of trampolines in the game, and some folks seem to be having difficulty learning how to use them. I originally considered replacing them all with water-spouting geysers. But after creating, adding and tweaking the geysers, I decided to keep most of the trampolines, and replace just a few with geysers to help give the game a bit more variety. The geysers are much easier to maneuver on than the trampolines and achieve the same result (they both help Unga get back up to the higher platforms)

[b]Bear Sniffing Damage[/b]
I saw a few screenshots and videos where players were able to walk behind the bear and push him around, as if Unga had some butt sniffing super power. This was caused by a missing damage collider on the bear's hind end. This has been corrected. 

[b]Main Menu: Resolution[/b]
Players using a very high resolution of 3840 x 2160 or greater were seeing menu containers that were not meant to be seen. I moved these menu containers further away from the viewable area to prevent this from happening.  

[b]Main Menu: Tips[/b]
I added random tips in the center of the main menu. For example; a chart that explains how stars can be earned throughout the game, as well as tips for using the trampoline and log vaulting. I will be adding a few more in the next update.

More To Come!

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
[b]Minor Prop Adjustments[/b]
While watching other players play online, I noticed a few tiny problem areas that hadn't revealed themselves during beta tests. I'll continue fixing small issues like these as they arise. If you want to help out, please take screenshots of weird behaviors, and share them with me. I'll be happy to update the game with needed improvements.

[b]Jump Adjustments[/b]
I've watched several videos where players seem to have difficulty holding Energy and Jump simultaneously, so I have tweaked the Jump settings. Now, the game ALWAYS uses Energy when Jumping, regardless of whether you are holding Shift or not. The result is a slightly higher jump, with less stress on the Shift button's usage.

More To Come!

notes.title: Update 1.1 (Quick Fix)
notes.content:
[b]Player Speed[/b]
Adjusted the default player speed. Now, the base speed is almost as fast as the Energy Boosted Speed, making the game a little less reliant on holding SHIFT all of the time, and less of a burden when energy runs out.

[b]Controller Configuration[/b]
Made changes to the default controller button configurations. Energy (for Running) is now B and/or RB on XBOX Controller, and Left and/or Right Shift on Keyboard.

[b]Star Trader[/b]
The Star Trader icon no longer appears on the main menu unless the player has enough stars to trade. 

We are already working on the next update. 
More To Come!
